facts.title: NEL Isagi balance
facts.text: Two Gun Volley −40%, speed +5%; Demon King distance −12.5%, speed +5%; Direct Shot distance −5%, speed +10%; Adaptive Win distance −40%, speed +10%; Meta Burst/Side Step cooldown 40s → 32.5s.

facts.title: NEL Isagi–Hiori
facts.text: Hiori uses Hard Freeze Counter-Attack on NEL Isagi; after the cutscene, use highlighted Direct Shot before the window ends.

facts.title: GK changes
facts.text: GK throws gained i-frames; Kaiser Magnus and NEL Isagi Demon King fixed to be saveable by human goalkeepers.

facts.title: NEL evolutions
facts.text: NEL Nagi and NEL Isagi questlines and NEL wheel introduced. Their reworks were still upcoming in this announcement.

facts.title: Direct Pass and Direct Shot
facts.text: NEL dash cooldown 25s and new Direct Pass with 200m range, no auto-track. Base Direct Shot aimable with 20s cooldown; Fadeaway cooldown reduced and distance increased.

facts.title: Chemical reaction roster
facts.text: New NEL Isagi–Kaiser and NEL Nagi–NEL Reo; Hiori–Isagi and Sae–Shidou changed; Bachira–Otoya removed. Follow-up says the intended Sae–Shidou rework was not shipped.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Kaiser–Kiyora chemistry
history.text: New Isagi Final Shot cutscene and My Finest Clown MVP. Borderline to Kaiser can trigger the Kaiser Magnus chemistry after the pass connects.

history.title: Dragon Drive and overtime awakening
history.text: Added aerial C-key Dragon Drive to NEL Shidou and custom awakening bars. Overtime grants awakening to one random player on each team.

history.title: July quality of life
history.text: New awakening bars, titles and Bachira MVP.

history.title: Awakening and performance fixes
history.text: Awakening bars draining during cutscenes fixed across many styles; major crash and lag fixes announced for new servers.

history.title: NEL 2.0
history.text: New academy and position selection, career stat tiers, team offers and repeatable quests. Goals, steals, assists and saves drive ranking rather than passes.

history.title: NEL Isagi–Hiori chemistry
history.text: Hiori's Hard Freeze Counter-Attack to NEL Isagi highlights Direct Shot after the cutscene; using it triggers chemistry.

history.title: NEL Hiori rework
history.text: NEL Hiori received a revised kit; chemistry with NEL Isagi was described and released June 7. Heel Flick returned to Magical Turn.

history.title: Mobile controls and fixes
history.text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

history.title: May cutscene and skill fixes
history.text: Fixed Panther Shot direction, infinite Center of Gravity, MetaBurst steal animation, ball visibility and awakening cooldown reset bugs.

history.title: NEL Isagi rework
history.text: Reworked NEL Isagi kit and shop reward system.

history.title: Nagi and Isagi evolution
history.text: NEL questlines and wheel introduced; Generational rarity removed, with Generational styles moved to World Class at the time.

history.title: Rebalance bug fixes
history.text: Fixed a wide range of ability bugs including full-field Street Sweep, Bloodlust, NEL Isagi–Kaiser chemistry cooldown and awakening interactions.

history.title: Great rebalancing
history.text: Ball Trajectory Metavision for all goalkeepers, Loki and Nagi. Loki base/passive overhaul; extensive style cooldown and range changes, removals and vaulting.

history.title: Isagi Lefty Shot removed
history.text: Lefty Shot removed and Direct Shot restored as an on-ball move at this date.

history.title: October mini-patch
history.text: Cutscene, inventory, battle pass, performance and awakening follow-up fixes. Rivalry chemistry softlock addressed.

history.title: Rivals chemical reaction and Demon King
history.text: Rivals chemistry at defending kickoff when both centre forwards use NEL Isagi and NEL Rin; World Class Demon King flow introduced.

history.title: Prodigies versus Talented Learners
history.text: NEL Rin and NEL Isagi were reworked for the event.

history.title: Chemical reaction system
history.text: Receiver can request a chemical reaction; a button appears to initiate it.

history.title: Ball physics and style balance
history.text: Ball physics made independent of FPS; King, Isagi, Yukimiya and flow balances announced.

history.title: Ego's Summer Strike
history.text: Limited 4v4 tournament with strike system and goalkeeper locked. Earlier Hiori–NEL Isagi chemistry announced.

history.title: Golden Defense and Lefty Shoot
history.text: Golden Defense changed to no teammate pass and ignore i-frames; Lefty Shoot delay fixed.

history.title: NEL Isagi update
history.text: NEL Isagi introduced with Direct Shot and Lefty Shoot among its abilities.

history.title: Big Bang Drive and Isagi changes
history.text: Big Bang Drive required an airborne ball; Isagi second ability reworked and Direct Pass removed at this date. Sae awakening and flows revamped.

history.title: Reo and Nagi update
history.text: Reo style and flow, Nagi shooting ability and flow, Sae–Shidou chemistry and Isagi U20 goal added.

history.title: Early gameplay patch
history.text: Direct Shot fixed, tackle speed increased and duration reduced; Nagi aerial tackle issue addressed.
